To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) SVMs are a good choice of machine learning method for SRL; 2) standard features are sufficient for SRL; and 3) our system outperforms all the other Arabic SRL systems submitted to SEMEVAL.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and evaluation of a system for semantic role labeling (or shallow semantic analysis) of Modern Standard Arabic.
developing a system for SRL in Arabic.

the following: (1) the design of a semantic role labeling system for Arabic based on SVMs; (2) the design of an Arabic semantic lexicon and a set of features for the task; (3) the design of experiments to evaluate our semantic role labeling system on Arabic; (4) a comparison of our system against other systems in the field; and (5) a comparison of Arabic SRL systems against other systems in other languages.

a simple, standard system can perform well on Arabic SRL, and that there is still a large gap between Arabic and other languages in terms of SRL performance.
